definitions.gloss: personnel change; staff transfer; organizational reshuffle
definitions.explanation: Changes in personnel assignments within an organization, including transfers, promotions, demotions, and departmental reassignments. A routine practice in Japanese companies, typically occurring in April.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be personnel changes in April.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the sales department in the personnel reshuffle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{騒然|そうぜん}→騒然：15689_souzen⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A large-scale personnel reshuffle was announced, and the office is in an uproar.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese companies, {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう} typically happens at the start of the fiscal year (April) or mid-year (October). It is a normal part of corporate life and can include transfers to different departments, branch offices, or even subsidiaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ (personnel changes are announced)
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内示|ないじ}→内示：18056_naiji⟧ (unofficial notification of transfer)
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう} (regular personnel reshuffle)
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (personnel transfer season)
